Labs are done in class, saved into your course GitHub repo, and submitted by posting your repo link on Courseworks. This page grows week by week.

## Week 1 (Sep 10)

- **[Lab 0a — Getting set up](lab0a.qmd)**: GitHub account, private course repo, LEAP hub · verification notebook: [verify_setup.ipynb](verify_setup.ipynb)
- **[Lab 0b — Python, just enough to start](lab0b_python_basics.ipynb)**: notebooks, numpy, matplotlib, a first look at pandas and xarray
- **[Lab 0c — The climate of NYC](lab0c_nyc_climate.ipynb)**: distributions, a hand-fit 3-parameter model, ERA5 vs CMIP6
- **[Lab 0d — A bucket](lab0d_bucket.ipynb)**: budgets, equilibrium, stepping forward in time

## Week 2 (Sep 17)

We covered the energy-balance models in lecture but did not reach the labs. Lab 1b moves to Week 3; Lab 1a is optional practice.

## Week 3 (Sep 24)

**Lab 1b is due this week.** Save your completed notebook in your course GitHub repository and submit the repository link on Courseworks.

- **[Lab 1b — Adjustment over time](lab1b_adjustment.ipynb)**: complete all four sections in class, including the changing-flux experiments and discussion · <a href="https://dhruvbalwada.github.io/intro-climate-modeling-fall2026/labs/lab1b_adjustment.ipynb" download>Download notebook</a>
- **[Lab 1a — Equilibrium and energy conservation](lab1a_equilibrium.ipynb)**: optional practice with equilibrium temperatures and energy budgets · <a href="https://dhruvbalwada.github.io/intro-climate-modeling-fall2026/labs/lab1a_equilibrium.ipynb" download>Download notebook</a>

Find the slides and lab links in the [schedule](../schedule.qmd). For LEAP, GitHub, and submission instructions, see [Lab 0a](lab0a.qmd).

## Week 5 (Oct 8) {#week-5-oct-8}

Work through these notebooks in order:

1. **Gregory plots from CMIP6:** diagnose radiative forcing and feedback from a climate-model experiment. <a href="https://dhruvbalwada.github.io/intro-climate-modeling-fall2026/labs/gregory_cmip6.ipynb" download>Download notebook</a>
2. **Fast and slow climate responses:** explore surface and deep-ocean heat storage. <a href="https://dhruvbalwada.github.io/intro-climate-modeling-fall2026/labs/two_box_ocean.ipynb" download>Download notebook</a>
3. **Regional climates and heat transport:** explore two equal-area tropical and polar boxes. <a href="https://dhruvbalwada.github.io/intro-climate-modeling-fall2026/labs/two_box_transport.ipynb" download>Download notebook</a>

**[Download all three labs and supporting files](week05_labs.zip)** and unzip them before opening the notebooks. The package includes saved CMIP6 annual means for the Gregory notebook: set `USE_SAVED_MEANS = True` to use these instead of reading cloud data. Keep the `data` folder beside the notebooks. The two box-model labs need no downloads.

[Slides (PDF)](../slides/week05.pdf) · [Running instructions](week05_README.txt) · [Python packages](week05_requirements.txt)
